prompt.alinti: You have to see this amazing YouTube alternative. It's called PipePipe, and it's currently sitting at 6,439 stars on GitHub because it fixes all those little annoyances we deal with every single day. Think of it like a souped-up version of your standard video app that actually lets you take control of your screen. You know how annoying it is when a video is interrupted by a long-winded sponsorship pitch that you didn't ask to hear? This app automatically skips those sections for you so you can get right to the good stuff without reaching for your phone. It even brings back those helpful dislike counts and lets you hide all the distracting short-form videos cluttering your feed. It's like having a personalized viewing experience that's built for your comfort rather than for keeping you trapped on the platform. Go check out the PipePipe page on GitHub to see it.
